title: eludite.git.worktrees input
description: Worktrees (the Git Repository window's Worktrees): `list` (default) with their branch and path; `add` one named `name` under `<repo>/.worktrees/<name>` (Eludite's convention, docs/briefs/README.md) or at `path`, checking out `branch` (default: a new branch `name` at HEAD); `remove` one, only when its working tree is clean unless `force` (refused for agents). The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.
x-eludite-escalates: `add` and `remove` are class execute; `force` is refused for agents outright.

branch.description: An existing branch to check out in it.

force.description: Remove a worktree with changes. Refused for agents.
